name: HF1-major1-consent-consumption
command:
set -e
python3() { command nice -n 19 python3 -I "$@"; }
export -f python3
source scripts/setup-ffmpeg.sh
c1_runtime="$PWD/target/ja1-s3-hooks-fix1/runtime"
export LOCALAPPDATA="$PWD/target/c1fix-localappdata" TMPDIR="$c1_runtime/tmp"
export XDG_STATE_HOME="$c1_runtime/state" XDG_DATA_HOME="$c1_runtime/share"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$c1_runtime/cache" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$c1_runtime/config"
mkdir -p "$LOCALAPPDATA/Kinewright/recovery" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_STATE_HOME" "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
test "$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)" -ge 6291456
